findings.claim: A missing `)` in an if condition is reported on the wrong line. With `if (rank == null {` on line 12, the editor shows "Error, line 15: ')' expected. Every ( needs a matching ): check the brackets on line 15." Line 15 is `return rank + " of " + suit;`, and its brackets are balanced. By 14.9 the header is `if ( Expression ) Statement`, so the `)` is missing before the `{` on line 12, and that is the line to change. A single-line case (a missing `)` inside one return statement) is reported on its own line, so only the header-plus-block shape is affected. Rated medium: a missing `)` before `{` is a common beginner slip, the message sends the learner to a line that is already correct, and the line reported is part of simulator fidelity. Reproduced headless in Chromium (Playwright) against the current bytes at c0066ed8; no JDK is installed, so javac was not run and its exact wording is not asserted.
findings.recommendation: When the statement pass meets an unclosed `(` in an if, for or while header and then reaches the `{` that opens its body (or a depth-0 `;`), report "')' expected" at after() of the token before that `{`/`;`, so the line shown is the header line. Never report it at the end of the enclosing body.

findings.claim: The new exact-text check rejects legal toString bodies that print exactly `Q of hearts`, and the attempt counts as a checked try. `return (rank + " of " + suit);` gets "Almost: 4 of 5 checks pass. Return the rank, the joining text and the suit, with nothing before or after them." plus "You have one more checked try", although a parenthesized expression has the value of the expression inside it (15.8.5). A null guard `if (rank == null) return "?";` before the correct return, which is a legal unbraced if (14.9) and still prints `Q of hearts` for this card, is also marked Not yet, because the check reads from the first return. Rated low: neither form is typical at this level, but the check consumes a try with a false Not yet. Reproduced headless in Chromium (Playwright) against the current bytes at c0066ed8; no JDK is installed, so javac was not run and its exact wording is not asserted.
findings.recommendation: Strip one pair of parentheses around the whole return expression, and test the last top-level return statement (or report a body with several returns as not supported, which is not a try).
